question: The Jealous Witch is known to be a silver-haired half-elf; are there also legends about the races of the other witches? If it’s not too much trouble, could you tell us what they were?
answer: They’re not passed down. In fact, in that world, when people say “witch”, it means “The Jealous Witch”, so in general, the fact that six other witches existed isn’t handed down from one generation to the next, and their names aren’t known.
